info.title: MICROSERVICE-PROD-Update Corporate Finance By Param1-spec
info.description: The Corporate Finance Update API enables businesses to modify specific financial records based on unique parameters. This endpoint allows users to update various attributes of corporate finance data, ensuring that information remains accurate and up-to-date. Typical consumers include financial analysts and corporate finance teams who need to adjust financial entries in response to changing business conditions. This API is essential for maintaining data integrity and supporting real-time financial analysis.

bearerAuth.description: This security scheme utilizes a Bearer authentication mechanism where a JSON Web Token (JWT) is provided as a means to authenticate requests.
